ModMetaData.name: Date Night
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Adds Date and Lovin slots to the Schedule tab. Dates are dinner, walks, stars, gifts — mood and opinion, no bed. Lovin uses a shared double.
Adults can grow a relationship step by step: friends, sweethearts, then boyfriend/girlfriend, then lovers. Lovin stays locked until they are a real pair. Optional Romance on the Rim: Date Night yields while RotR is already running a kiss, stroll, or proposal, and a finished date fills RotR's romance need. Optional RimJobWorld: Lovin hours start RJW's bed job instead of fighting vanilla Lovin.
Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7. Safe to add mid-save. Before removing: clear Date / Lovin slots back to Sleep / Anything.
Full notes: https://azraelgodking.github.io/rimworld_mods/date-night Discord: https://discord.gg/Vwh2y7qMXv
